content: Hello, I am new here, sorry if I am posting in the wrong place. I am having an autocomplete problem in vscode. I am running lean 4.33 and vscode 1.128.0. When I am editing a lean file and I type something, say "h", I get an autocomplete list. I want to press escape to make the autocomplete list go away, which works in other file types, e.g. C files. But after the list goes away, it immediately appears again. I can't find any way to make it go away apart from either left/right arrow to navigate away, or alternatively disabling the entire autocomplete functionality which I don't want to do. I asked claude and it found https://github.com/leanprover/lean4/issues/8430, which is not quite the same but maybe related? Any suggestions how to fix this?
I’m facing the same problem. VScode used to not have this annoying problem
Does this happen on the latest VSCode? (1.133.0)
nvm this just happened to me on that version, macOS
For me this has been going on for several weeks, though I don't remember how long exactly. I also use a Mac.

The following two config settings (which you can access via Settings UI) seem to fix the problem

    "editor.inlineSuggest.minShowDelay": 500,
    "editor.acceptSuggestionOnEnter": "off",

I think the problem was caused by the 1st parameter being set at 0ms. A 500ms delay seems to be a sweet spot. The 2nd parameter make TAB the only way to accept a suggestion. Typing ENTER now just adds a newline.

Might be the following VS Code issue, which is independent of Lean: vscode#323796

Are you using Copilot or some other tool that uses VS Code's inline suggestion feature (greyed-out text suggestions)? I wonder if it might be related to this recent change in VS Code, and whether setting

"editor.quickSuggestions": {
  "other": "on"
}

back to its previous default fixes the issue.

I don't have Copilot or any other inline suggestions enabled, but setting other: on does fix it :folded_hands:
I've had other: offWhenInlineCompletions set for a while, so they seem to have broken something about its behavior, not just changed defaults
